svg.title: The eight chapters and their recorded uses of one another
svg.desc: Eight chapters on a ring around the grammar, sized by their results (The root 86, The map 101, Knowing and testing 110, Life and evolution 46, Collectives and selection 74, The classical texts 16, Significance and alignment 104, Method and the formal core 21); 539 formal-reuse uses between chapters, 17 pairs with at least 10 drawn, 221 of the uses running backward, an earlier chapter's results using a later one's, drawn darker where a pair has 10 or more (the chapters are numbered for reading, not as an order of proof); spokes to the grammar give each chapter's core modules that state their laws on it (The root 22 of 74, The map 16 of 82, Knowing and testing 14 of 88, Life and evolution 8 of 23, Collectives and selection 3 of 28, The classical texts 4 of 10, Significance and alignment 19 of 71, Method and the formal core 4 of 26); the places of the 117 central declarations against the edge of one root (11 derived, 1 under a stated hypothesis, 6 counting, 99 at a named distance); under the places, the five shared laws with the central rows on each and those reaching the grammar (Closure 42 rows, 42 reach; Balance 54 rows, 16 reach, represented, not derived; Finite runs 14 rows, 14 reach; Lumping 2 rows, 1 reach; Widening 8 rows, 1 reach); three boxes come into chapter 7, what ranking results take as hypotheses where their theorems take them: the continuation condition held de se (whose losses count, ranking nothing), self-concern (an order ranking above what it widens every widening that adds to one's own continuation, read as what lies within one's reach, which where the condition holds de se, read across all steps, ranks every widening above on a finite listing; that a life forms it is not shown) and C (Comparison, a requirement on an order: with every claim counted as living, that it rank each course above every course it widens); T1 to T8 at their homes, coloured by test outcome.
svg.text: The eight chapters and their recorded uses of one another
Drawn from the theory graph: each circle sized by its chapter’s results; each solid curve counting
one chapter’s uses of another’s results recorded as formal-reuse, dashed and dotted curves between
The chapters are numbered for reading, not as an order of proof: 221 of the 539 uses between
chapters run backward, an earlier chapter’s results using a later one’s (the darker curves; only
formal-reuse curves of pairs with 10 or more are drawn).
Places of the 117 central declarations against the edge of one root (08 §7):
11 derived, each a case of grammar theorems
99 at a named distance, each with its reason
The five shared laws (08 §7): central rows on each; hatched, those whose compiled type or value
Rows, not declarations: 87 of the 126 central rows (nine declarations stand in two) rest on at least one law,
some on several. Reaching the grammar is not being derived: only the 11 derived above are read as cases of
grammar theorems, and 1 as a root form at one step, under a stated hypothesis. A bar of few rows is widened to
be seen; the words give the counts.
